evidence.detail: The class builds and owns the 36000-series interface rooted at id 36000, including exact labels 'Item List Title', 'Description Line 1', tab selectors, a search input, list background assets, and a scrollable item-entry region.

Surviving literals and resources include 'Search by item', '<img=39> Search for an item', search result text, 'Go back', and 'Search description text', fixing the interface as an item-list/search surface rather than a generic widget builder.

The same interface installs item-list actions including Remove 1/5/10/All, Deposit 1/5/10/All, 'Deposit all to bank', and 'Deposit all to inventory', showing that the list can bridge selected items with bank/inventory operations.

Its static methods mutate the same constructed 36000-series widgets, tab state, descriptions, search state, list contents, visibility, and layout; ScriptPacket 14 delegates its multi-mode updates directly into those methods.

proposals.note: ItemListInterface is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the 36000-series item-list/search interface builder/controller. No surviving original source noun was found; confidence is 0.997.

evidence.detail: R115 ScriptPacketDispatcher registers this exact class as ScriptPacket 14.

The handler also updates ItemListInterface-owned arrays and builder nodes used for the five tabs and scroll/list layout, tying its broad mode surface to one coherent item-list interface subsystem rather than unrelated client state.
